name: simforge
description: SimForge: Reusable Remotion + React Three Fiber framework for procedural 3D simulations & vertical video generation

scripts.render:dungeon: remotion render DungeonTrap out/dungeon-trap.raw.mp4 --concurrency=8 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/dungeon-trap.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/dungeon-trap.mp4
scripts.render:boulder: remotion render RollingBoulder out/rolling-boulder.raw.mp4 --concurrency=8 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/rolling-boulder.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-2.0:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/rolling-boulder.mp4
scripts.render:cave-home: remotion render CaveHome out/cave-home.raw.mp4 --concurrency=8 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/cave-home.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-2.0:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/cave-home.mp4
scripts.render:nuclear-bunker: remotion render NuclearBunker out/nuclear-bunker.raw.mp4 --concurrency=4 --offthreadvideo-cache-size-in-bytes=1073741824 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/nuclear-bunker.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-2.0:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/nuclear-bunker.mp4
scripts.render:dart-trap: remotion render DartTrap out/dart-trap.raw.mp4 --concurrency=8 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/dart-trap.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/dart-trap.mp4
